schedule_in_past: Pick a time that hasn't passed yet.
schedule_time_nonexistent: {{local}} doesn't exist in {{zone}}, because the clocks skip ahead then. Pick another time.
schedule_time_ambiguous: {{local}} happens twice in {{zone}} when the clocks go back, at {{earliest_offset}} and at {{latest_offset}}. Pick which one you mean.
schedule_zone_unknown: {{zone}} isn't a time zone we know. Pick one from the list.
native_schedule_outside_window: This platform can only hold a post between {{min_ms}} and {{max_ms}} milliseconds ahead. Pick a time inside that window, or let postit send it at that time.
format_unsupported: This platform has no way to post this kind of content ({{inferred}}).
text_required: Write some text for this post.
text_too_long: The text is {{actual}} characters; this platform allows {{max}}.
media_required: Add a photo or video to this post.
media_count: This platform takes {{min}} to {{max}} files; the post has {{actual}}.
media_missing: A file in this post no longer exists. Remove it or upload it again.
media_kind_not_allowed: This platform doesn't take {{kind}} files. It takes: {{allowed}}.
media_type_not_allowed: This platform doesn't take {{content_type}} files. It takes: {{allowed}}.
media_too_large: A file is {{actual_bytes}} bytes; this platform allows {{max_bytes}}.
media_dimensions: A picture or video is {{width}} by {{height}}, which this platform doesn't accept. Pick another size.
media_aspect_ratio: A file's shape is {{actual}}; this platform wants between {{min}} and {{max}}.
media_duration: A video is {{actual_ms}} milliseconds long; this platform wants between {{min_ms}} and {{max_ms}}.
media_not_ready: A file is still being prepared, or couldn't be prepared. Wait a moment or upload it again.
reply_to_required: Say which post or comment this answers.
reply_to_not_allowed: This platform can't post replies this way.
override_media_not_in_post: This account's version uses a file the post doesn't have.
override_media_duplicate: This account's version lists the same file twice.
email_document_required: Write the email for this account.
email_subject_required: Add a subject to the email.
email_too_large: The email is {{actual_bytes}} bytes with its links; mail servers accept {{max_bytes}}. Shorten it or use fewer images.
email_postal_address_required: Add your postal address to this email account. Every email needs one in its footer.
email_merge_tag_invalid: A merge tag in the email isn't written correctly, or sits inside a link.
option_unknown: {{name}} isn't an option this platform has.
option_type: {{name}} has the wrong kind of value; it should be {{expected}}.
